articles.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
articles.snippet: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

articles.title: Senate's top Democratic investigator looking into Tether payments to Bo Hines' firm
articles.snippet: Senator Richard Blumenthal, the ranking Democrat on the investigations subcommittee, added a probe of the ex-White House crypto adviser to his list of crypto interests.

articles.title: US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
articles.snippet: The Democratic ranking member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations asked Paolo Ardoino for records related to a reported deal between Tether and Nxum.

articles.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
articles.snippet: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.

articles.title: HSBC launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin for retail payments
articles.snippet: HSBC is rolling out RedCoin wallets to PayMe users, with plans to support tokenized investment subscriptions and expand into institutional uses.
